seeds.what_the_environment_seed_changes: The seed sets NumPy's global generator in the simulator process; it is set anew before every episode's reset. The start state then overwrites the joint positions and velocities of the scene. What the seed still decides is what the reset draws that is not part of that state: the benchmark places its fixtures (cabinet, stove, rack) at every reset within the ranges of the task's file, 1-2 cm. A fresh environment's first seeded reset always gives the same placement; a later reset of the same environment gives it in most tasks but not in all. So every reset's placement is compared with the scene's first, and the environment is built anew when it differs: every episode of a task starts from the same placement, whatever was run before it.

rollout.stop: the episode ends at the first step at which the predicate holds, or at the step limit
rollout.reset: environment seed, reset, start state, before every episode; the reset's placement of the fixtures is checked against the scene's first and the environment built anew when it differs
rollout.retry: none: an episode that raises is written with stopped = error and run again by the next launch

observation.image: uint8, as the simulator returns it, not flipped
observation.camera_parameters: intrinsics and extrinsics of both cameras at every query

endpoints.success: the BDDL goal of the task's file, checked after every policy step

parameters.close: the first policy step whose executed gripper command is > 0 after a command <= 0 (the gripper starts open)
parameters.close_is_on: the object or fixture owning the geom whose centre is nearest the gripper site at the frame after that step; every geom of every body of the entity counts
parameters.contact: the first policy step with a gripper geom in contact with a geom of an object or fixture
parameters.part: where the target names a part: the first contact with a body of the target's entity named like the target's body with another word in the part's place; the entity's other bodies (its frame) are skipped
parameters.reach_first_contact: the first entity touched is the target's entity and, where a part is named, the first part touched is the named one
parameters.entity_bodies: the bodies whose name is the entity's name or starts with it and an underscore; a body matching several entities belongs to the longest name

sha256.how: sha256 of every file of the snapshot loaded

inference.action_head: L1 regression, parallel decoding (use_l1_regression True, use_diffusion False, use_film False)

steps: JPEG round trip and Lanczos resize to 224 (tf)

inference.state: read: eef position, axis-angle from the quaternion, gripper joints (8); BOUNDS_Q99 with the suite's statistics; one token
inference.prompt: In: What action should the robot take to {instruction.lower()}?\nOut:
inference.unnormalisation: BOUNDS_Q99 with the key <suite>_no_noops, chosen per episode from its suite; gripper not un-normalised
inference.gripper: 2x - 1, then sign (binarized), then x -1: env -1 open, +1 close
inference.release_environment_seed: env.seed(0) once per task (not used here)

noise_seed_controls: nothing: the L1-regression head is deterministic (no sampling); the seed only seeds torch, numpy and random at the start of the episode
